svg.text: Arduino UNO R4 WiFi · 4 × JST XH 3-pin · Direct digital I/O · Resistors inside main unit
Same pin mapping on all 4 buttons.
Signal pins: D2/D4/D6/D8 · LED pins: D3/D5/D7/D9
INPUT_PULLUP on signal pins — no external
Unplugged socket = pin reads HIGH = ignored.
Button module contains only: illuminated momentary switch + JST XH 3-pin socket · All resistors housed in main unit
